title: The Veil of the Ninefold Court
author: Ines Pemberton
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
